primary_evidence.supports: The name input exists and is passed directly to the underlying upload-artifact step.
The artifact_name input exists with the default github-pages.
Deployment lists current-run artifacts, filters exact artifact-name matches, and errors when zero or multiple matches remain.
run_id persists across reruns, while run_attempt increments for each rerun.
The github context is available in jobs.<job_id>.steps.with.

reasoning: For this single job, a rerun repeats upload and deployment with the same incremented attempt number. Both steps agree on a new name and do not match artifacts from earlier attempts.
limits: This addresses same-run retry name collisions; it does not guarantee immediate artifact metadata visibility or repair the original zero-artifact response.
If upload and deployment are later split into separately rerun jobs, preserve the upload name through a job output rather than recomputing a possibly newer attempt number in a deployment-only rerun.
actions_taken: Read official public action source/docs and produced a local proposal only. No shared workflow edit, deployment call, permission change or external source execution.
